proposal.hypothesis: Vectorized float4 loads/stores with one vector per thread will saturate memory bandwidth for the 512x4096 elementwise bias-GELU while retaining a scalar fallback for unaligned widths.
Vectorized float4 loads with 4 vectors per thread and FP32 tanh GELU should saturate memory bandwidth on the 512x4096 tensor while reusing the cached 4096-element bias.
